race.description: Nutrien Gold Crown Sale Graduate Final
race.comment: THE MYTEE DUCK (13) made a nice return at his latest appearance a week ago, finishing 6 metres away in second over 1730m at this track. Not drawn to best so may need a 10/10 drive. This looks a sterner test than last time but he is fitter for that last hit-out and capable of making his presence felt. HIGHVIEW BONNIE (3) put together a string of minor placings then raised her game last start to score by 6 metres over 1730m at this track on August 19. Will enjoy a nice run from this favourable starting position. This looks a sterner test than last time but she is good enough to take this out. SHOWEMHOW (2) is looming as a real threat after a better effort last start, finishing third at this track over 1730m. LUCIENDO BIEN (12) is in the mix if he can recapture the form from two starts back that saw him finish second over 1609m at Menangle.
